title: Cobblemon Aris
description: Explore, battle, and build in a seamless fusion of Pokémon and Minecraft with this feature-rich Cobblemon modpack
body:
⚔️Aris Cobblemon Server Modpack A friendly Cobblemon server focused on community, progression, and fun!

Features Available Now:

✅NPC shops at spawn (Cobblemon items + all enchanting books)

✅Diamonds as server currency

✅Global Trade Station (GTS) for easy trades

✅Wonder Trade

✅Loot crates

✅Expanded shop (TRs + most Minecraft items)

Coming Soon:

🔹Daily calendar rewards

🔹Pokédex rewards

🔹Player & NPC gyms + Elite Four

🔹Raids & co-op challenges

Our Goal: A balanced, community-first Cobblemon experience where you can trade, battle, and grow as a trainer with friends!
